title: A dual characterization and algorithm of general optimal stopping
summary: We present a novel dual approach to characterizing the solution to optimal stopping problems for strong Feller processes on locally compact, separable metric spaces. Our characterization builds upon reinterpreting a standard result in optimal stopping theory as a dual formulation, which yields computationally tractable algorithms. Our framework is applicable to a broad class of Markov processes.
